statement: Let $T$ be the standard $20$-simplex of volume $V$, $\Gamma=(20/21)^{20}$, and use the actual integer fibers $r_jT$ at $j=0,1,2,3$ with $r=(94,97,100,103)/100$. If $0\le\lambda\le4\Gamma^2$, then both $\Gamma+\lambda(97/100)^{20}$ and $\Gamma(103/100)^{20}$ are strictly below $(\Gamma/2)\sum_{j=0}^3r_j^{20}$. This includes the sharp subset coefficient $\lambda_{20}$ of 4b772ae7fa6b3293. These numbers, multiplied by $V$, are the specified single-middle subset and heaviest own-fiber lower payments. The actual point $(2,g_T)$ has depth strictly above that target multiplied by $V$.
title: A four-simplex monotone family separates two lower payments from actual depth
